title: MINT: Meeting-time Indicators for Truncation in Multi-Step Off-Policy RL
abstract: arXiv:2611.24413v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many multi-step off-policy temporal-difference methods handle policy mismatch through products of per-step trace coefficients, leading to a trade-off between variance control and long-horizon signal. The maximum trace length consequently becomes a sensitive hyperparameter. We propose MINT (Meeting-time INdicators for Truncation), which replaces these products with a binary stopping indicator: one until coupled behavior and target trajectories first meet, zero thereafter. At the true value function, the indicator's idempotence yields a variance bound governed by meeting-time survival. For practical implementation, a single sampled action provides a model-free surrogate for the stopping rule, requiring no transition model or mixing-time estimate. We derive separate sufficient conditions for contraction of the state-coupled operator and its practical surrogate under fixed-policy evaluation. On MuJoCo and DeepMind Control tasks, MINT outpe

translated_title: MINT：面向多步离策略强化学习截断的相遇时间指标
translated_abstract: 许多多步离策略时序差分方法通过每步轨迹系数的乘积来处理策略失配问题，这导致了方差控制与长时程信号之间的权衡，使得最大轨迹长度成为一个敏感的超参数。我们提出了 MINT（Meeting-time INdicators for Truncation，用于截断的相遇时间指标），它用一个二元停止指标来替代这些系数乘积：在耦合的行为轨迹与目标轨迹首次相遇之前取值为 1，之后取值为 0。在真实价值函数处，该指标的幂等性产生了一个由相遇时间生存概率所支配的方差界。在实际实现中，只需单次采样的动作即可为该停止规则提供无模型代理，无需转移模型或混合时间估计。我们在固定策略评估下，分别推导了状态耦合算子其实际代理算子收缩的充分条件。在 MuJoCo 和 DeepMind Control 任务上，MINT 的表现优于现有方法。
tldr: 该论文提出 MINT 方法，用一个基于行为轨迹与目标轨迹首次相遇时间的二元停止指标来替代传统多步离策略强化学习中的逐轨迹系数乘积，从而免除了对敏感截断长度超参数、转移模型及混合时间估计的依赖，同时兼顾方差控制与长时程信号。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes MINT, which replaces per-step trace coefficient products in multi-step off-policy RL with a binary stopping indicator based on when coupled behavior and target trajectories first meet, eliminating the need for a sensitive truncation-length hyperparameter, transition models, or mixing-time estimates while balancing variance control and long-horizon signal.
